CLINICAL TRANSLATION: The primary endpoint was continuous complete remission at 1 year with an effect size of 36%. Without a comparator or p-value, this appears to be a single-arm trial reporting a 36% continuous CR rate. For newly diagnosed ALL, historical benchmarks for intensive chemotherapy regimens typically achieve 80-90% initial CR rates, making 36% continuous CR at 1 year a poor result. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This appears to be a single-arm trial without a control group, making interpretation challenging. However, the 36% continuous CR rate is well below expected benchmarks for this population and regimen type.
